fact_text: CPI inflation fell to 9.6 percent in August 2024, the first single-digit reading in about three years, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: The analyst says rents, petroleum prices, perishables such as vegetables and meat have risen sharply, so the headline CPI may not match what households feel on the ground.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: In earlier monetary policy decisions the benchmark rate was cut in steps of about 100 basis points, and the analyst expects a larger cut at the upcoming meeting.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: A large rate cut could make KSE-100 blue chips attractive, since the analyst sees the market stalled while investors wait for the monetary policy statement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: A 12 billion dollar rollover from friendly countries underpins an expected IMF facility, which the analyst says has not yet reached the IMF board, so investors are waiting.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: Under the Special Investment Facilitation Council, OGDC, PPL, PSO and Pakistan Refinery are being offered to foreign investors, which the analyst says could revive the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: Pakistan's untapped sedimentary basins need drilling with larger equipment and foreign technology, which the analyst has argued for about 20 years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: The analyst cites PSO's circular debt of roughly 800 to 900 billion rupees as a stuck exposure that weighs on the stock whenever news about it arrives.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)

fact_text: The Sensitive Price Indicator fell to about 108 in Aug 2024 from about 157 in Jul 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'CPI Drop to 9.6% | Is Inflation Finally Under Control ? |Insights on SIFC Companies | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-05)
